{{Quote|You landed on the wrong planet, friend. The Republic isn't welcome here|[[Gaan]], to [[Joc Sah]]|<ref name="OO" />}}
'''Ragmar V''' was a barren, [[Desert/Legends|desert]]-coated [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its population center was an outpost of outcasts of various [[Species/Legends|species]], who were opposed to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
{{Quote|There's a primitive settlement a few klicks from here. Several life forms detected, sir|[[Remy (clone trooper)|Remy]], to Joc Sah|<ref name="OO" />}}
Ragmar V was an underdeveloped and arid world with a sparse population. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had a [[Atmosphere/Legends|breathable atmosphere]]. There were no large [[City/Legends|cities]] on Ragmar V; the locals lived in small villages. The fauna of Ragmar V consisted of small green [[Lizard/Legends|lizards]] that inhabited the canyons, as well as solitary [[Bird/Legends|birds]] circling above the surface.<ref name="OO" />

==History==
{{Quote|I was just hoping for some real action for my first solo mission.''"<br />"''Sometimes the smallest fights become the biggest battles. Stay on your guard.|Joc Sah and his master, [[Sev (Jedi)|Sev]]|<ref name="OO" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a gang of criminals operated on Ragmar V, led by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Gaan]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|305|Gaan}}</ref> Among the members of Gaan’s gang were representatives of many different [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknogs]], [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]], and many others. The gang was highly dissatisfied with the rule of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and fought against it during the conflict.<ref name="OO" />

[[File:SettlementOnRagmar.jpg|thumb|left|280px|The outpost of outcasts on Ragmar V]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|the final year]] of the war, Republic forces were dispatched to Ragmar under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Sev (Jedi)|Sev]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Joc Sah]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] intended to seize Ragmar, as the planet served as a key staging point for the Republic’s planned assault on a nearby [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base. Joc and his small squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] landed in one of the planet’s deserts aboard a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] and were immediately attacked by bandits from Gaan’s gang. Discovering a small settlement that also served as the gang’s headquarters, Sah and his [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] rushed toward it. A [[Battle of Ragmar V|battle]] nearly erupted between them and Gaan, but before fighting broke out, the Padawan’s soldiers received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and opened fire on their commander instead of the bandits. Fortunately for Joc, Gaan and his men sided with him and defeated the attackers.<ref name="OO" /> Soon after their victory, the gang, together with the Padawan who had joined them, took shelter in one of Ragmar’s deserts.<ref>{{CSWECite|III|123|Sah, Joc}}</ref>
